transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this approval meeting for the joint research agreement with our university partner. Before I can sign off on this agreement, company policy requires a formal recorded readout from both the Intellectual Property Counsel and the Privacy and Clinical Regulatory Counsel. I'd like to start by hearing from IP Counsel on the relevant findings and required actions, and then from Privacy and Clinical Regulatory Counsel. Please go ahead whenever you're ready.

transcript.text: I have a critical finding from my review. Yesterday I confirmed with the product lead and privacy office that the company's non-negotiable clinical-data position is to prohibit publication containing patient-level data and to require de-identification before any permitted external publication. The working-session minutes have not yet been circulated to the deal team. This is directly relevant because the current draft permits publication of project results without specifying these protections. The required actions are: (1) the final agreement must explicitly prohibit publication containing patient-level data, and (2) the agreement must require de-identification before any permitted external publication. I have not yet incorporated these requirements into the draft.
